docTitle: Bibilia ku Ramani · Bibilia mu Kuzunguja Kumo
metaDesc: Tongelaga ikanza lya Ilagane lya Kale, bupanga bo ng'wa Yesu, na maduluko ga ng'wa Paulo ha ramani ya lyoli — Bibilia yaboneka mu mahantu ga lyoli.

s.title: Bibilia ku Ramani
s.verse: “Nguno aho twamulangaga ī mihayo ya būdūla bo ng'wa Seeba wise Yesu Kilisito nī ya kūshoka kwakwe, twalī tūtalondeelaga ngano ja nyasala sala, bise benekīlī gete tūlī bambona bago a magaka gakwe genayo.” (2 Petelo 1:16)
s.purpose: Bibilia iti buhabi. Ili ng'wandiko gwa banhu abo bagenda ha mahantu ga lyoli, shiku ja lyoli, na mina ga lyoli. Tongelaga nzila jenijo ha ramani, mu nzila ya ikanza — dindaga hantu, au dindaga ▶ kugenda mo mhayo na mhayo.
s.ot_kick: ① Ilagane lya Kale — mu ikanza
s.ot_lead: Iti luduluko lumo dūhū aliyo guli kushikiliija kwa buchaaji bo bupiji kufuma kuseema: kuseema na kugwa → mafuliko na Babeli → kwitanwa (Abulahamu) → si ilagene → Kufuma Misili → buchondi → kuhema → butemi → kwabanyiwa → buchaaji → kushoka.
s.je_kick: ② Ilagane Lipya — bupanga bo ng'wa Yesu
s.je_lead: Tongelaga bupanga bo ng'wa Yesu giti umo Ng'hulu Jawiza jikulomeela, mu nzila — kufuma kubyalwa kwakwe Betelehemu, kubita mu kubatijiwa na butumami bo Galilaya, kubita Samalia, kushisha nsalaba, kuzuuka na kuja igulu Yelusalemu.
s.pa_kick: ③ Ilagane Lipya — maduluko ga ng'wa Paulo
s.pa_h: Kufuma Antiokia kushisha ngelelo ya si — Loma
s.pa_lead: Kufuma Pentekoste ya Yelusalemu, ginehe u Ng'hulu Jawiza jikuduluka kubita Buyudaya — kubita Asia Ndoo na Ulaya kushisha moyo gwa butemi butaale. Solaga luduluko lumo mu ntano (lwa kwandya · lwa kabili · lwa katatu + luduluko lwa kuja Loma + hanyuma ya kulekwa) na utongele mihayo ya Shītwa sha Batūng'wa hamo na malete ganandikwa mu nzila.
s.foot: Nzwilo · A mahantu gakutongela mihayo ya Bibilia na jiografia ya Bibilia iyo imanikile (hamo na mina ga buno aha gakukombelija). A mpelo ja nyanza, jiji, na nyanza jandolwa kufuma ku data ya jiografia ilekejilwe (Natural Earth), yipeejiwe.

eden.name: Edeni (Kuseema · Kugwa)
eden.note: Mu si iyo yaseemwa yawiza no, u shibi gwingila na gukudumula u buliyani bo gati ya Mulungu na banhu.
events: Kuseema mu shiku sita — “yawiza no”
Munhu kuseemwa giti shikolelo sha ng'wa Mulungu
Kugwa, na kwingiijiwa kufuma Edeni
Ilagane lya kwandya lya Ng'hulu Jawiza — “u myalwa wa nkima akutobagula ntwe gwa nzoka”

noah.name: Ararati (Mafuliko)
noah.today: Lugulu lwa Ararati, Buturuki bo ng'walilo lelo
noah.note: U Mulungu akulamula si iyijwie shibi, aliyo akulanhija bupanga ku kaya yimo.
events: Si iyijwie bubipi
Mafuliko, na safina ya ng'wa Nuhu
Ilagane lya nkondo gwa mbula — “gutalabiza hangi mafuliko ga kubiipya si”

babel.name: Nzenga gwa Babeli
babel.note: Kubukilija u kwibona kutaale uko kukoba kushika kwigulu, u Mulungu akulundubya lulimi lwabo na kubasambaza banhu mu si yose.
events: “Tuzenge ng'waniki na nzenga ntaale… twitogele lina lise”
U Mulungu akulundubya lulimi lwabo
Banhu bakusambala mu si yose (Shinari — hanyuma Babuloni)

ur.name: Uri
ur.note: U ng'hulu ya bupiji ya Bibilia yikwandya na kwitanwa kwa munhu ūmò.
events: U Mulungu akuntana Abulamu kufuma Uri wa Bakaladayo
“Nakukwita ubize ihanga itaale… a banhu bose bakwilukilwa mbango kulwa nguno yako”
Ku kuzunya akuleka isi yakwe

haran.name: Halani
haran.note: Mu nzila, akwitawula u kwitanwa kuja si ilagene.
events: Kaya ya ng'wa Tela yikwikala Halani
Tela akucha
Abulamu akwandya lugendo kuja Kanani ali na myaka 75

shechem.name: Shekemu · Kanani
shechem.note: Mu si ilagene kaya yikwimijiwa na u ilagane likushokela ku ng'haya na ng'haya.
events: Kwingila Kanani, shitambililo sha kwandya — “myalwa wako nakuninha isi yiyi”
Ilagane (wandījo 15) · Isaka · Yakobo
Baana 12 ba ng'wa Yakobo — nzizo gwa shikolo 12

egypt.name: Misili (Gosheni)
egypt.note: Kaya yikubiza ihanga itaale — hama ihanga lya basese.
events: Yusufu, wagulijiwa, akubiza ntemi Misili
Kaya yose ya ng'wa Yakobo yikwiza Misili kupela nzala
Ihanga lya Isilaeli likukula na likubiza busese

sinai.name: Lugulu lwa Sinai
sinai.note: U bupiji butaale bo Ilagane lya Kale — basese bakubiza banhu ba ng'wa Mulungu.
events: Mapigo 10 na ng'holo ya Pasaka
Nyanza Ntūnduuli gukwabanyiwa na bakukila
Shilagilo 10, i Shilagilo, ihema na shitambo

kadesh.name: Kadeshi (buchondi)
kadesh.note: U kutazunya kukutwala ng'haya kubela isi — aliyo u Mulungu akikala habipi nabo.
events: Bapelezi 12 — aliyo a banhu bakulema kuzunya
Myaka 38 mu buchondi — mana, liwingu na moto
Ha luwanda lwa Moabu, nhungwa ya bukalikijo ya ng'wa Musa (Kūshokeela)

jericho.name: Yeliko
jericho.note: Ku bukalikijo bakwingila na bakusola si ilagene.
events: Yolodani gukwabanyiwa na banhu bakukila
Shibumbililo sha Yeliko shikugwa
Kuhema Kanani na kwabanya isi

shiloh.name: Shilo (Balamuji)
shiloh.note: Atina ntemi, buli ng'wene akiitaga giti walitogelilwe — ntemi wa ng'hana akutaagwa.
events: Ihema likwimijiwa Shilo
Muzunguko gwa shibi–makoye–bupiji (Debola, Gideoni, Samsoni)
Luuzi — bukini mu shiku ja giiti, mu ng'haya ya Daudi

jerusalem.name: Yelusalemu · Butemi bumo
jerusalem.note: Ikanza itaale lya Isilaeli — na ilagane lya ntemi wa welelo bose.
events: Sauli ntemi wa kwandya, hama Daudi na Goliati
Ilagane lya ng'wa Daudi — “lisumbi lyako welelo bose” (2 Sang'weli 7)
Solomoni akuzenga hekalu mu Yelusalemu

samaria.name: Samalia · Butemi bwabanyiwa
samaria.note: U butemi bukwabanyiwa na bukunyiha aho bahangi bakulila.
events: Hanyuma ya ng'wa Solomoni, kwabanyiwa kubiza Yuda na Isilaeli
Kukumilija shihango kuyaga
Eliya, Isaya, Yelemia bakulila ‘galukagi’ — na bakuhanga Masiya

nineveh.name: Ninawi (Ashuli)
nineveh.note: Kuleka buli buhugulo, u butemi bo kunfunha bukugwa hakwandya.
events: Ninawi, ng'waniki ntaale gwa Ashuli
Butemi bo kunfunha bukugwa kuli Ashuli (B.C. 722)
Yona akutumwa Ninawi

babylon.name: Babuloni
babylon.note: U bwilo bo giiti no — aliyo u ilagane lya kushokeela likushinga.
events: Yelusalemu gukugwa, hekalu likulimba (B.C. 586)
Yuda bukutwalwa Babuloni
Danyeli na Ezekia — kuzunya na shibonelo mu buchaaji

susa.name: Susa (Pelusia)
susa.note: Nūūlū ha moyo gwa butemi bo bapagani, u Mulungu akubalanhija banhu bakwe.
events: Pelusia bukuhema Babuloni
Esita akubapija a Bayudaya kufuma kubulagwa
Nehemia akulomba ha butongi bo ntemi na akutumwa

return.name: Kushoka Yelusalemu
return.note: Bakushoka na kuzenga hangi — aliyo atiho ntemi uyo wiza. Bakwisagilwa Masiya.
events: Maduluko gatatu ga kushoka ku luhugu lwa ng'wa Kolesi (Zelubabeli 538 · Ezila 458 · Nehemia 444)
Hekalu likuzengwa hangi na shibumbililo sha Yelusalemu shikubeejiwa
Malaki — Ilagane lya Kale likumala: “nakwitūma inhungwa yane”

bethlehem.name: Betelehemu
bethlehem.note: U Masiya uyo walaganijiwa akiza mu ng'waniki gwa ng'wa Daudi — u Mhayo wabiza munhu.
events: Kubyalwa Betelehemu, ng'waniki gwa ng'wa Daudi
Bamalaika bakukaaniija ng'hulu kuli badimi
Banyabusala bakwiza kunkumya

nazareth.name: Nazaleti
nazareth.note: U Mulungu akukula giti munhu mu ng'waniki gudoo.
events: Kukulila mu numba ya nsongaji wa mbao
Ali na myaka 12, akuuja na kushosha mu hekalu
Hanyuma akulemwa mu sinagogi ya ng'waniki gwakwe

jordan.name: Lwiji lwa Yolodani
jordan.note: U butumami bwakwe bo hape bukwandya — igulu likunkomelija giti Ng'wana.
events: Kubatijiwa na Yohana
U Moyo akwika giti njiwa — “Uyu Ng'wana wane ntogwa”
Akuhema magelo gatatu ga ng'wa Shetani mu buchondi

cana.name: Kana
cana.note: Mu shikolwa shakwe sha kwandya akubonelaja ikujo lyakwe.
events: Ntumilwa ha ng'wenzo
Minzi gakugaluka kubiza divai — shikolwa shakwe sha kwandya
Bafundwa bakwe bakunzunya

sychar.name: Sikari (Samalia)
sychar.note: Nzila ya butumami bo kwandya — kubita Yelusalemu kushisha Samalia iyo banhu bakayibela.
events: Akoja hekalu mu Yelusalemu
Bujiku, Nikodemo — “Wigeleelilwe kubyalwa bupya”
Minzi ga bupanga kuli nkima Nsamalia

capernaum.name: Kapernaumu
capernaum.today: ha lubali lwa nyanza ya Galilaya lelo
capernaum.note: Hantu ha kwikala ha butumami bo Galilaya — kwitana, kutulanga na bulwisho pyi jikutana haha.
events: Akubatana balobi ba nswi na akwikala haha
Nhungwa ya ha Lugulu — “Bali na mbango abo bali balala mu moyo”
Nfano ja butemi — na bulwisho bukukula

galilee.name: Nyanza ya Galilaya
galilee.note: Ku nguzu igulya lya shiseeng'wa akubonelaja uyo ali wei.
events: “Humula, imilaga” — akuhumuja nkubuko gwa nyanza
Akulisha banhu 5,000 ku mikate itano na nswi ibili
Akugenda igulya lya minzi

caesarea_p.name: Kaisalia Filipi
caesarea_p.note: Bafundwa bakwelewa giki wei ali Kilisito, na nzila ya nsalaba yikwiguka.
events: Kuzunilija kwa ng'wa Petelo — “Wiwi uli Kilisito, Ng'wana wa ng'wa Mulungu ng'wa bupanga”
Akwandya kuhanga kucha na kuzuuka kwakwe
Akugalulwa mu ikujo ha lugulu

jericho.name: Yeliko
jericho.note: Mu nzila ya kudula kuja Yelusalemu, akukoba abo balimiile.
events: Akumpa meso Balitimayo mboku
Akuntana Zakayo ntoji wa kodi
“Ng'wana wa Munhu wiza kukoba na kupija abo balimiile”

bethany.name: Betania
bethany.note: Akubonelaja butaale igulya lya kucha ha nyangwa ya juma yakwe ya bukalikijo.
events: Akunzuuja Lazalo kufuma mu kaburi — “Nene nali kuzuuka na bupanga”
Malia akunsinga mono kulwa kuzikwa
Shikolwa shenishi shikukomeja mpango gwa kumbulaga

jerusalem.name: Yelusalemu
jerusalem.note: U nyangwa iyo Bibilia yose yikujilaga — nsalaba, kuzuuka, kuja igulu.
events: Kwingila kwa ikujo; akugalula meza ga hekalu hangi
Ha Shalya sha Bukalikijo akoja magulu ga bafundwa
Akucha ha nsalaba
Akuzuuka ha lushiku lwa katatu, hama akuja igulu

antioch.name: Antiokia
antioch.note: Kanisa lya kutuma aha butumiwa bo mahanga bukwandya na bukushokela.
events: Mu kulomba u Moyo akubasagula Balinaba na Sauli
Kanisa aha bazunya bakatanwa ‘Bakilisto’ hakwandya
Hantu ha kwandiila maduluko ga kwandya, ga kabili na ga katatu

seleucia.name: Seleukia
seleucia.note: Bandari ya Antiokia — bakwandya lugendo lwa mu nyanza kuja Kipro.

salamis.name: Salami (Kipro)
salamis.note: Hantu ha kwandya ha Kipro — kulomeela mu masinagogi.

paphos.name: Pafo
paphos.note: Nguzu jikubonekana kubukilija abo bakulwisha Ng'hulu Jawiza.
events: Elima ndagi akubulwa kubiza mboku
Selegio Paulo ng'waliwa akuzunya
Kufuma haha ‘Paulo’ akutongela

perga.name: Perga
perga.note: Bandari mu Pamfilia — haha Yohana Maliko akushoka nyuma.

pantioch.name: Antiokia ya Pisidia
pantioch.note: U Ng'hulu Jawiza jikwiguka kuja ku mahanga.
events: Nhungwa ntali ya buchaaji bo bupiji mu sinagogi
Mahanga mingi gakuyega na gakwanukula u Mhayo
Bakubingiijiwa ku bulwisho

iconium.name: Ikonio
iconium.note: Bingi bakuzunya, aliyo kuluhijiwa kukubatwala ha butongi.

lystra.name: Listra
lystra.note: Bakuntana giti mulungu, hama akuponwa mawe.
events: Akudamya munhu ntibu kufuma kubyalwa
Ilundo lya banhu likugema kubafunyila shitambo giti milungu
Akuponwa mawe na kulekwa giti wamala kucha, aliyo akwima

derbe.name: Derbe
derbe.note: Bafundwa bingi bakwitwa; bakushoka nzila yabo kukomeja makanisa.

troas.name: Troa
troas.note: Hantu ha kugaluka aha Ng'hulu Jawiza jikwandya kuja Ulaya.
events: Shibonelo sha munhu wa Makedonia
“Izaga uku utukombelije”
Bakukila bwangu kuja Ulaya

philippi.name: Filipi
philippi.note: Kanisa lya kwandya lya Ulaya — Ng'hulu Jawiza jikuhema nūūlū mu kudindilwa.
events: Lidia, nsuluji wa nguo ntunduuli, akuzunya
Ng'wana nkima nsese wa kulagula akulekwa huru
Njimbo ja bujiku bwa gati, kutinginika kwa si, kaya ya ndindaji akupijiwa

thess.name: Thesalonike
thess.note: U Mhayo gukutinginya ng'waniki na bulwisho bukwiluula.
events: Akuyombola mu sinagogi mu maSabato gatatu
“Aba bagalula si yose”
Bakushimila bujiku

berea.name: Beroya
berea.note: Abo ‘ba ng'holo njiza’ abo bakuupeleleja u Mhayo bichene.
events: Bakwanukula u Mhayo ku buyegi butaale
Buli lushiku bakupeleleja Mayandiko kulola ulu ni ng'hana
Bingi bakuzunya

athens.name: Atene
athens.note: Mu ng'waniki gwa banyabusala akukaaniija u ‘mulungu uyo atamanikile’.
events: Akununhilwa ku ng'waniki gwijwie shihango
Ha Aleopago akulomeela Nseemi na kuzuuka
Bakunseka, aliyo badoo bakuzunya

corinth.name: Kolinto
corinth.note: Akwikala mwaka na nusu, akuzenga kanisa mu ng'waniki gwa shibi.
events: Akwita mahema hamo na Akila na Pilisila
“Utogohaga… nguno nali hamo nawe”
Bakolinto bingi bakuzunya na bakubatijiwa

ephesus.name: Efeso
ephesus.note: Moyo gwa luduluko lwa katatu — u Mhayo gukuduluka mu Asia yose.
events: Kutulanga buli lushiku kulwa myaka ibili mu numba ya ng'wa Tilano
Shitabo sha budagi shikulimba; shikolwa sha nguzu
Demetilio nsongi wa hela akwandya nyonzo

miletus.name: Mileto
miletus.note: Kulaga kwa shisoji na banamhala ba Efeso.
events: “Dimaji kanisa ilo waligula ku sakami yakwe ng'wenekili”
Banamhala bakulila, bumanile giki bataamona hangi

caesarea.name: Kaisalia
caesarea.today: ha mpelo ya nyanza ya Isilaeli lelo
caesarea.note: Kulwa myaka ibili akwilanga kulwa Ng'hulu Jawiza ha butongi bo balwali na ntemi.
events: Malamula ha butongi bo balwali Felikisi na Festo
Kwilanga kwakwe ha butongi bo Ntemi Agilipa
“Nakulomba nlamulwe na Kaisali” — kuja Loma

jerusalem.name: Yelusalemu
jerusalem.note: Kudimwa mu hekalu, nzila yakwe giti munhu wakomelwa yikwandya.
events: Akudimwa na ilundo lya banhu mu hekalu
Akwilanga ha butongi bo libalaza
Giti nkaya wa Loma, akutumwa hasi ya balindaji kuja Kaisalia

myra.name: Mira
myra.note: Bakuluta mu ngalawa ya Alekizandiliya iyo yaja Loma.

fairhaven.name: Bandari Jawiza (Krete)
fairhaven.note: Buhugulo bo ng'wa Paulo bo kuleka lugendo lwa mu nyanza butazunilijiwa.

crete.name: Krete
crete.note: Hanyuma ya kulekwa, kisiwa aha akunleka Tito kubeeja makanisa mu nzila.
events: Akunleka Tito kubatula banamhala mu buli ng'waniki
Akulomba batongeeli batina nzobo, bakini
Akwandika lilete kuli Tito

malta.name: Malta
malta.note: Kubita luhaga na kubipa kwa ngalawa, u ilagane lya ng'wa Mulungu likushinga.
events: U ‘nyaga gwa kunfunha-ng'walilo’ gukudumula ngalawa, aliyo bose 276 bakupona
Akulumwa na nzoka, aliyo atabipa
Akubadamya balwáji ba kisiwa

puteoli.name: Puteoli
puteoli.note: Bakushika Italia na bakwitwa na bazunya biyabo.

rome.name: Loma
rome.book: Shītwa sha Batūng'wa 28 · Malete ga Kudindilwa · 2 Timoteo
rome.note: U Ng'hulu Jawiza jikushika moyo gwa butemi butaale ku bukalikijo — iti ngelelo aliyo wandijo.
events: Myaka ibili hasi ya kudindilwa mu numba, akukaaniija butemi kutina woba
Kufuma haha akwandika Malete ga Kudindilwa (Baefeso·Bafilipi·Bakolose·Filemoni)
Hanyuma akudindilwa hangi, akwandika 2 Timoteo na akubulagwa kulwa kuzunya — “Nalwiile bulwi bwiza, namala mbilo”
